## Conditional build handoff

After explicit GATE-G8 approval, run the two narrowly authorized bootstrap contracts sequentially through `implement-spec`, using their own exact Run lines and fresh setup. Do not start an unguarded accumulating orchestrator loop to implement its guard. The permitted bootstrap exception ends when its implementation/proof is complete; failure returns a scoped integration decision.

After retained checks and actual chosen launch integration pass and all applicable authority is recorded, the normal entry is:

```text
orchestrate-build ledger=docs/build/LEDGER.md
```

Manual floor after those same prerequisites: read the current ledger/manifest/contract, run the retained guard, invoke that exact eligible contract's `implement-spec` Run line, perform scoped verification/history/CI checks, and record completion through one state writer. Gates are operator records; skeletons are fleshed by scoped decompose-spec and reviewed before any Run line exists. Neither path is authorized by this readiness document.
